main.description: A revision to a note, stored as a diff from the previous revision.

noteRef.description: AT-URI of the parent note record.

parentRevision.description: AT-URI of the previous revision. Omitted for the first revision of a note.

diff.description: The diff content in the format specified by diffFormat.

message.description: Optional commit message describing this revision.

snapshot.description: Full note content as of this revision, written periodically so replay can re-anchor instead of depending on every earlier diff applying cleanly.

blobs.description: Blobs referenced by this revision's content.
